title: Рисуване на Canvas
subtitle: Контекст, координати и фигури
crumb: Игри с JavaScript и Canvas · урок 1

steps.caption: Canvas е празно платно с размер в пиксели.
Контекстът 2d е четката: цвят, после правоъгълник.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="240"
        style="background:#1e1b4b"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
ctx.fillStyle = "tomato";
ctx.fillRect(20, 20, 120, 70);
</script>

steps.caption: Началото (0, 0) е горе вляво, а y расте надолу.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="240"
        style="background:#1e1b4b"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
ctx.fillStyle = "tomato";
ctx.fillRect(20, 20, 120, 70);
ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
ctx.fillRect(150, 100, 120, 70);
</script>

steps.caption: Кръгът се рисува с път: beginPath, arc, fill.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="240"
        style="background:#1e1b4b"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
ctx.fillStyle = "tomato";
ctx.fillRect(20, 20, 120, 70);
ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
ctx.fillRect(150, 100, 120, 70);
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(330, 60, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047";
ctx.fill();
</script>

steps.caption: fillText пише текст със зададен шрифт и цвят.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="240"
        style="background:#1e1b4b"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
ctx.fillStyle = "tomato";
ctx.fillRect(20, 20, 120, 70);
ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
ctx.fillRect(150, 100, 120, 70);
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(330, 60, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047";
ctx.fill();
ctx.font = "20px sans-serif";
ctx.fillStyle = "white";
ctx.fillText("Здравей, платно!", 20, 215);
</script>
